description.value: Spice Magic is an Indian restaurant located in Penticton, BC, offering flavours from the Indian subcontinent to locals and visitors alike. Penticton sits at the heart of the Okanagan cycling circuit between Skaha and Okanagan lakes, making it a natural stop for touring cyclists moving through the region. The website is live but minimal, so cyclists should contact the restaurant directly to confirm details before visiting.
